def event_keypress(self, anEvent=None):

    if anEvent.keysym == 'Escape': exit()
    elif anEvent.keysym == 'space': self.run = not self.run
    elif anEvent.keysym == 'r':

        for aTile in self.dTiles.values(): aTile.alivechance()

        for aTile in self.dTiles.values(): aTile.clear()
